title: Stock Market Today, April 10: CoreWeave Jumps After Multi-Year AI Cloud Deal With Anthropic
title_zh: 4 月 10 日今日股市：CoreWeave 在与 Anthropic 达成多年人工智能云交易后股价上涨
summary: CoreWeave's new big AI contracts with Anthropic and Meta are reshaping its growth runway and risk profile, today, April 10, 2026.
summary_zh: 今天，即 2026 年 4 月 10 日，CoreWeave 与 Anthropic 和 Meta 签订的新大型人工智能合同正在重塑其增长跑道和风险状况。

title: CoreWeave stock surges on multiyear AI deal with Anthropic
title_zh: CoreWeave 股价因与 Anthropic 达成多年人工智能协议而飙升
summary: CoreWeave (CRWV) and Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) have partnered on a multiyear cloud deal. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley goes over the details.
summary_zh: CoreWeave (CRWV) 和 Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 已就一项多年云协议展开合作。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 详细介绍了这些细节。

title: Cloudflare Sell-Off Offers Buying Opportunity as Project Glasswing Concerns 'Overblown,' Oppenheimer Says
title_zh: 奥本海默表示，由于 Glasswing 项目担心“言过其实”，Cloudflare 的抛售提供了买入机会
summary: Cloudflare's (NET) stock sell-off offers a buying opportunity, while concerns around Project Glasswi
summary_zh: Cloudflare (NET) 的股票抛售提供了买入机会，同时对 Project Glasswi 的担忧

title: CoreWeave stock climbs 10% on Anthropic deal
title_zh: Anthropic 交易推动 CoreWeave 股价上涨 10%
summary: Anthropic and CoreWeave have entered into a new agreement that will see CoreWeave's AI infrastructure power Anthropic's various models.
summary_zh: Anthropic 和 CoreWeave 已达成一项新协议，CoreWeave 的人工智能基础设施将为 Anthropic 的各种模型提供支持。

title: SBA Communications Stock Soars on Buyout Interest. What It Means for Tower Stocks.
title_zh: SBA Communications 股价因收购兴趣而飙升。这对塔楼股票意味着什么。
summary: SBA Communications stock has surged on takeover interest, but analysts warn a potential deal could cap valuations across the tower industry.
summary_zh: SBA Communications 股价因收购兴趣而飙升，但分析师警告称，潜在的交易可能会限制整个铁塔行业的估值。
